title: Microsoft bought about $1.4B of Arista network gear in 2024

sources.quote: For example, sales to our end customer Microsoft represented 20%, 18% and 16% of our total revenue for the years ended 2024, 2023 and 2022 respectively.

explain: Microsoft is one of Arista's two biggest customers for the high-speed switches that link servers in its cloud and AI data centers. Arista's annual report says Microsoft was 20% of its 2024 revenue of $7.0 billion, so roughly $1.4 billion; that dollar figure is our calculation, not a number Arista reported.
